speakerposition: Speaker of the House of Commons
speechtext: I have the honour to inform the House that Nelson Riis, Esquire, Member for the Electoral District of Kamloops-Shuswap, has been appointed as a Member of the Board of Internal Economy for the purposes and under the provisions of Chapter 39 of the Statutes of Canada, 1985, entitled: An Act to amend the House of Commons Act.

subtopic: WAYS AND MEANS TABLING OF NOTICE OF MOTION
WAYS AND MEANS TABLING OF NOTICE OF MOTION
speechtext: Mr. Speaker, I have the honour to lay upon the Table, pursuant to the provisions of Standing Order 84(1), Notices of Ways and Means Motions, and pursuant to the provisions of Standing Order 84(2) I ask, Mr. Speaker, that you designate an Order of the Day for the consideration of the Ways and Means Motions to amend the Income Tax Act pertaining to the prepayment of the child tax credit and the Ways and Means Motions to amend the Excise Tax Act and the Excise Act.

PRESENTATION OF NINTH REPORT OF THE CANADIAN NATO PARLIAMENTARY ASSOCIATION
speechtext: Mr. Speaker, pursuant to Standing Order 101, I have the honour to present to the House the Ninth Report, in both official languages, of the Canadian NATO Parliamentary Association prepared by the Hon. Member for Okanagan-Similkameen (Mr. King).

speakeroldname: Hon. Don Mazankowski (Deputy Prime Minister and President of the Privy Council):
speakerposition: Deputy Prime Minister; Vice-President; President of the Privy Council; Leader of the Government in the House of Commons; Progressive Conservative Party House Leader
speechtext:
Mr. Speaker, there have been some discussions with the House Leaders of the other two Parties with respect to the proceedings for tomorrow and I think that you would find that there would be unanimous agreement to the following:
That on Friday, October 3, 1986, the House shall continue to sit between 1
p.m. and 2 o'clock p.m. for the purpose of continuing the debate on the
Address in Reply to Her Excellency's Speech from the Throne.
Mr. Speaker, we in the New Democratic Party certainly agree with this provision in the spirit of providing for more comprehensive and cohesive speeches from our three Leaders.

speakerposition: Chief Opposition Whip; Whip of the Liberal Party
speechtext: Mr. Speaker, I would confirm that there has been negotiations and we agree.

speakerposition: Speaker of the House of Commons
speechtext: The House has heard the terms of the motion. It is the please of the House to adopt the motion?

speakerposition: Speaker of the House of Commons
speechtext:
Carried and so ordered.

October 2, 1986
The Address-Mrs. Collins
